query: What sustainability and governance models support long-term stewardship of an independent minority archive run largely by volunteers and local partners?

response.query: What sustainability and governance models support long-term stewardship of an independent minority archive run largely by volunteers and local partners?
response.answer: A participatory governance model with strong volunteer leadership and local partnerships supports long-term stewardship of a minority archive. Transparent decision-making and community engagement are key. Sustainability is ensured through continuous volunteer training and resource sharing.

results.title: Corporate Governance: The New Paradigm
results.content: In this framework, if a corporation, its board of directors and its CEO and management team are diligently pursuing well-conceived strategies that were developed with the participation of independent, competent and engaged directors, and its operations are in the hands of competent executives, investors will support the corporation and refuse to support short-term financial activists seeking to force short-term value enhancements without regard to long-term value implications. The International Business Council of the World Economic Forum believes that recognition and acceptance of the New Paradigm by corporations, their CEOs and boards of directors, and by leading institutional investors and asset managers, will create a corporate governance framework that will facilitate sustainable long-term value. In the New Paradigm, the CEO, who leads the management of the corporation, and board of directors, which oversees the management, play a front-and-center role in ensuring that the corporation pursues sustainable long-term value creation and fosters meaningful relationships with investors.
